notes: Instance, node, DDL-task and redistribution detail queries expose explicit identity inputs and documented terminal states.
Redistribution readiness for switching is distinct from successful completion. DDL warnings are not clean success.
Order submission is not provisioning or renewal completion. Health-check counts and metrics do not define asynchronous lifecycle readiness.

request_notes: GET renewal and unsubscribe remain confirmed mutations without retries. Health and connectivity checks are read-only diagnostics.
Table creation and schema permissions preserve conditional requirements. Property-value requirements that depend on previously retrieved property metadata remain server-validated.
response_notes: Use authoritative statusCode=800/900 for DRDS operations; deprecated code/result aliases remain captured data, not alternate success predicates.
Commercial operations use their documented statusCode=200, with nested submitted or isSucceed guards when those fields explicitly indicate business success.
Five contradictory or unrelated response examples are retained only as raw evidence; no synthetic successful responses are substituted.
